  PROBLEM: Serena bootstrap failures can be emitted as SERENA_FALLBACK both by setup_serena.sh and by the caller-side fallback branch.
  WHY: cost_audit.py counts each SERENA_FALLBACK line separately, so a single failure is reported as two telemetry events.

  PROBLEM: The caller-side `if ! ... bash scripts/setup_serena.sh` failure blocks are unreachable because setup_serena.sh always exits 0.
  WHY: The warning/env-export fallback code in those callers never runs, so the apparent failure handling is dead code.
- scripts/setup_serena.sh:11-18 | severity=medium | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: When invoked without a slash in BASH_SOURCE[0], SCRIPT_DIR falls back to $(pwd) instead of the script’s directory.
  WHY: That can point SERENA_TEMPLATE_PATH at the wrong template location and break bootstrap.
- scripts/setup_serena.sh:40-57 and scripts/validate_process.sh:549-557 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: emit_serena_fallback has incompatible argument order between the two scripts.
  WHY: A future caller can pass phase/reason in the wrong order and emit garbled SERENA_FALLBACK telemetry.
- scripts/setup_serena.sh:25-37 and scripts/validate_process.sh:535-552 | severity=low | confidence=4

  PROBLEM: The two scripts use different helper names and implementations for log sanitization.
  WHY: The duplicated helpers make telemetry formatting inconsistent and harder to maintain.
- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh:98-115 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: The new sed-based patching rewrites any model_reasoning_effort entry, not just the top-level one.
  WHY: A future section-scoped value would be silently overwritten with the diagnose reasoning level.
- scripts/setup_serena.sh (lines ~440-450, probe_mcp_handshake block) | severity=medium | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: The bootstrap flow never emits a SERENA_PROBE target=<slug> result=<ok|failed|skipped> line.
  WHY: The expected probe telemetry is absent, so probe outcomes are invisible to downstream log analysis.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:2170-2175 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: The Serena project preexistence check treats the untracked .serena/project.yml as new on every run.
  WHY: That skews the reuse metric even when the project already exists.
- scripts/cost_audit.py:557-633 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: The legacy_est_prompt_tokens_cmp column is printed even when there is no observed subset to compare against.
  WHY: The table header implies a comparison even when the value is just the full estimate.
